info.name: BookSpace — WP-3 Resources & Availability
info.description:
Manual verification for WP-3 Phases 2 and 3 (FR-3.1, FR-3.2, FR-3.3, FR-3.5).

Run the whole collection top to bottom with the Collection Runner: every request carries assertions, so a green run is a pass. Folders 00 and 01 set up state the later folders depend on, so do not run 02-05 on their own.

See docs/postman/README.md for the seeded accounts, what to look at by hand, and the three behaviours that look like bugs and are not.

item.name: 00 Setup — identities
item.description:
Logs in as each seeded account and stashes the token plus the user id.

The user id comes out of the JWT's `sub` claim, decoded in a test script, because **there is no endpoint that lists users** — see the README's 'Gaps this exercise found'. Without that trick there is no way to learn an approver's Guid from the API alone.

The Acme admin logs in LAST, so `accessToken` is the admin's when the later folders run.

item.name: Emptying the list is now REFUSED (422 ApproversRequired)
item.description: The invariant enforced from the approver side. Without this the state FR-3.3 rules out returns through the side door.

item.name: But SWAPPING approvers is fine — one request, no invalid state
item.description: This is why approvers use replace-the-set rather than per-row POST/DELETE: the per-row route would have to pass through the empty list refused above.

item.name: 04 Acceptance criteria
item.description: The two cross-cutting WP-3 criteria a client can demonstrate better than a test log: non-admins cannot write, and a cross-tenant id is a 404.

item.name: Member cannot create a resource (403)

exec: pm.test('403 carries no reason code — this is RBAC, not a rule', () => {

item.name: Member cannot set a schedule (403)
An APPROVER is a non-admin too — cannot assign approvers (403)
item.description: Approver sits between Member and TenantAdmin, so 'non-admin' has to mean every non-admin. Being an approver is not the same as choosing them.

item.name: A SysAdmin is refused too (403)
item.description: Not a bug. TenantMember requires the orgId claim, which decision 0009 deliberately omits for a SysAdmin — PRD 2: the Platform Operator must never see tenant booking content in routine operation.
